outside_window.finding: The ENA token lock-up waiver takes effect 2026-10-05. After that date the company can sell ENA treasury tokens for working capital, subject to Foundation ROFR and consent. It is a possible overhang on the ENA NAV that the common, and so the warrant, is priced on.

The warrant exercise shares (19.1M) and the selling-stockholder resale of 12.67M shares have been registered and effective since 2026-09-14. With the common above $11.50 the warrants are in the money and can be exercised continuously. It is undated supply and has no date inside the window.

The standard SPAC $18.00 redemption trigger (20 of 30 trading days, with 'equals or exceeds $18.00' language in the S-1/424B3) cannot be met inside the window. The common is about $14-16 and has not closed above $18. A redemption notice would cap the warrant's time value, but it is weeks away at the earliest.
